additional_info.subject: ID0483348-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/S0 170004177] Converter issue CRM:02889001285
additional_info.body:
Hallo Benjamin, good afternoon.
Good news! We managed to bring the charger back to operation, all 4 outlets with 400 kW ready to charge.
There was a problem with communication with Dispenser PLC, as it couldn't turn on the rest of the components on the dispenser side.
After we manually update the dispenser PLC, everything worked accordingly.
Now, the outlets are out of order because Lukas is doing some tests with the ELMS, as soon as the ELMS is installed the outlets will come back to operation or when the ELMS is disabled.
So, we are ready to do the tests next week.
I will close the ticket since it has been resolved, and you will keep in touch with Catalina.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
